reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduledAmount and reuses the matcher's own getApproxNumberThreshold for the 7.5% cent-rounded tolerance instead of recomputing it.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; schedule-template's own isbetween ternary is even removed in favour of the shared helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the range worst-case rule, and planning callers just pass their op.

scope.why: Only the helper, its planning call sites, tests and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Clean single definition, though inserting op as a positional parameter before inverse is easy to misuse, and display-only callers silently keep the old behaviour by omitting op.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts; planning sites (api schedules-get, schedule-template, forecast, schedules app updateActions/postTransactionForSchedule, preview transactions, Balance) pass the op to it
